tenderSchedule.title: PROVIDE AMBULANCE ON RENTAL BASIS AT VIJAYAPURA AIRPORT
tenderSchedule.description:
SELECTION OF AN AGENCY TO PROVIDE AMBULANCE ON
RENTAL BASIS AT VIJAYAPURA AIRPORT, VIJAYAPURA
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation

tenderAddress.blockNumber: KSIIDC, 4th Floor, East Wing, No 49, Race Course Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable
All other terms and Conditions are as per tender documents.
KSIIDC reserve the right to change the quantity of the vehicle. The vehicle requirement projected in the RFP are tentative only.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Relevant Experience in Providing Ambulance Services - The Bidder should have relevant past experience in providing at least 1 (one) similar service to other clients for minimum order value of INR 80.00 Lakh (Rupees Thirty Lakhs only) in last 5 (Five) years as on PDD. For proof of past experience, the bidders shall submit the client certificate mentioning the total order value of each assignment and the duration of the contract (Bidder can submit work orders of completed and ongoing services for proof for past experience). The same shall be uploaded in the E-procurement portal. Bidders References in the format at Section 3B The following documents issued by the client for the services / work should be submitted as proof of undertaking for the respective service. For Completed assignments-Work Order/ Contract / Agreement, Completion Certificate with order value and duration of contract. For ongoing assignments - Work Order issued by the client, Confirmation Letter from the client (In Companys Letter Head signed by the Authorized Signatory) mentioning the details (Duration of the service, Rentals paid as on date etc) of the ongoing services shown as proof.

Years of Experience - The Bidder should have minimum 5 (five) years of experience as on the date of notice inviting tender in providing Ambulance services for Central Government / State Government entities / Public Sector clients.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certification of Incorporation -Technical Proposal Submission Form at Section 3A-Details of the Bidder at Section 3I

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Capability of the Bidder to provide similar Vehicles (Minimum Vehicles required from the Bidder for Eligibility)-The bidder shall provide a list of minimum 6 vehicles (6 Ambulances Tempo Traveler by FORCE or equivalent) of 2023 Model or later with valid documents as provided in Section 3B Capability of the Bidder to provide similar Vehicles - List of Ambulances. All vehicles shall be commercially registered along with valid commercial Registration Certificate (RC), valid Road Tax permit, full comprehensive valid insurance, valid Fitness certificate with Name of owner/travel agency or duly registered Power of Attorney (if vehicles are not in the name of owner) to be submitted. Bidders References in the format at Section 3B-The following documents shall be submitted by the bidder- Commercial Registration Documents, Valid Registration Certificate (RC), Valid Road Tax permit, Full comprehensive valid insurance, Valid Fitness certificate with Name of owner/travel agency or duly registered Power of Attorney (if vehicles are not in the name of owner)

An Applicant should have, during the last 3 (three) years, neither failed to perform on any agreement, as evidenced by imposition of a penalty by an arbitral or judicial authority or a judicial pronouncement or arbitration award against the Applicant or its Associate, nor been expelled from any service or agreement nor have had any agreement terminated for breach by such Applicant or its Associate. (Applicants shall submit undertaking on companys letterhead with notarized affidavit and upload it in the e-procurement portal).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Applicants shall submit undertaking on companys letterhead with notarized affidavit

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have had an average annual turnover of at least INR 80.00 Lakhs (Rupees Eighty Lakhs only) for any of 3 (three) financial years out of last 5 (Five) financial years (i.e. FY 2021-22, FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26). Certificate from Statutory Auditor / Independent Auditor showing the average annual turnover of the company for the last 5 (five) completed financial years (i.e., FY 2021-22, FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26) in the format at Section 3H.

Not Blacklisted / Barred and Not Involved in Major Litigation Affecting Service Delivery - The Bidder should not have been blacklisted / barred by any Central or State Government or PSU and should not be involved in any major litigation that may affect or compromise the delivery of service required Further, in the last 5 (five) years, the Bidder or any of their Associates has neither failed to perform on any contract, as evidenced by imposition of a penalty by an arbitral or judicial authority or a judicial pronouncement or arbitration award against the Bidder, nor been expelled from any project or contract by any public authority nor have had any contract terminated by any public authority for breach on our part.
